verdict.rationale: Engage docs confirm that Audiences can be built from computed traits and synced to hundreds of destinations, so computed traits are usable in targeting. Predictive scores are suggested only by a pricing-page tagline about 'AI‑powered audiences', with no documentation of LTV, churn or purchase-propensity models. Missing for 10: documentation of how computed traits are defined and calculated on profiles, explicit predictive trait/score docs (LTV, churn, purchase propensity), independent or hands-on corroboration.
